description_en: You can this operation to obtain information about child user groups under a specified parent user group
description_zh: 获取指定父用户组下的子用户组信息
name: QueryUserGroupListByParentId

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the parent user group.

If you enter the ID of the parent user group, you can obtain the information of the child user group under this ID.
If you enter -1, you can obtain the sub-user group information under the root directory
parameters.help_zh:
父用户组ID。

当输入父用户组ID时，可以获取该ID下的子用户组信息。
当输入-1时，可以获取根目录下的子用户组信息
parameters.name: parent_user_group_id

Result.description_en: The information about the sub-user group

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the sub-user group was created

CreateUser.description_en: The creator of the sub-user group. The UserID of the Quick BI is used instead of the UID of Alibaba Cloud
CreateUser.description_zh: 子用户组创建者。此处为Quick BI的UserID，而非阿里云的UID

IdentifiedPath.description_en: Directory level of the sub-user group

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the sub-user group was last modified
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 子用户组最新修改时间

ModifyUser.description_en: The user who modified the subgroup. The UserID of the Quick BI is used instead of the UID of Alibaba Cloud
ModifyUser.description_zh: 子用户组修改者。此处为Quick BI的UserID，而非阿里云的UID

ParentUserGroupId.description_en: The ID of the parent user group

UserGroupDescription.description_en: The description of the sub-user group

UserGroupId.description_en: The ID of the sub-user group

UserGroupName.description_en: The name of the sub-user group

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
